## 2. Supervised Learning

Linear regression, logistic regression, generalized linear models, generalized additive models.

### 2.3 [Tree Models](supervised_learning/tree_models/tree_models.qmd)

Decision trees, random forests, gradient boosting, symbolic  regression.

### 2.4 [Probabilistic Models](supervised_learning/probabilistic_models/probabilistic_models.qmd)

Naive Bayes, Gaussian processes.
